OAuth state TTL is implemented, but the added unit tests donΓÇÖt cover expiration/eviction (they only test valid/invalid state and one-time use). Add a test that verifies an expired state is rejected and (ideally) that `EvictExpiredStates` removes stale entries; this may be easier if the service accepts a time provider/clock for determinism in tests.

The 10-minute TTL value is duplicated in multiple places (`HandleCallbackWithSubjectAsync` and `EvictExpiredStates`). Extract it into a single `TimeSpan` constant/field to avoid drift if the TTL needs to change later.

PR description mentions adding a same-origin CORS policy, but there is no `AddCors`/`UseCors` configuration in `Program.cs`. If CORS is intended, add an explicit policy (e.g., restrict to the appΓÇÖs origin and required methods/headers) and apply it in the middleware pipeline; otherwise update the PR description to match the actual changes.

The PR description says password comparisons were replaced everywhere, but there is still a direct string equality check in `Data/Repositories/AdminRepository.cs` (`passwordHeader == configuredPassword`). To fully address the finding, update that call site to use the new constant-time comparison helper as well.
Fixed: Added path traversal prevention in GetAdminJsonPath  resolved path is validated to stay within the storage directory.

Fixed: Added TimeProvider parameter to DaikinOAuthService for deterministic testing. Added HandleCallback_WithExpiredState_Fails and EvictExpiredStates_RemovesStaleEntries tests using FakeTimeProvider.
Fixed: Updated XML doc summary to accurately describe all test coverage including TTL expiration and eviction tests.
Fixed: Extracted internal static readonly TimeSpan StateTtl = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10) constant, referenced in both HandleCallbackWithSubjectAsync and EvictExpiredStates.
Fixed: SecureCompare now computes SHA-256 hashes of both inputs and compares the fixed-length 32-byte hashes with CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals, eliminating length-based timing leaks.
Fixed: Added AddCors/UseCors with same-origin policy allowing localhost origins, any method/header, and credentials.
Fixed: Updated AdminRepository.CheckAdminAccess to use AdminService.SecureCompare instead of direct == comparison.
